name: ntr_db_es_bottom_perf
xsql:
SELECT 
    -- Bottom 5 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 5 THEN CAST(rn_top AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS bot_5_rank,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 5 THEN name END), '') AS bot_5_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 5 THEN division END), '') AS bot_5_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 5 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS bot_5_val,
    
    -- Bottom 4 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 4 THEN CAST(rn_top AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS bot_4_rank,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 4 THEN name END), '') AS bot_4_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 4 THEN division END), '') AS bot_4_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 4 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS bot_4_val,
    
    -- Bottom 3 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 3 THEN CAST(rn_top AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS bot_3_rank,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 3 THEN name END), '') AS bot_3_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 3 THEN division END), '') AS bot_3_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 3 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS bot_3_val,
    
    -- Bottom 2 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 2 THEN CAST(rn_top AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS bot_2_rank,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 2 THEN name END), '') AS bot_2_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 2 THEN division END), '') AS bot_2_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 2 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS bot_2_val,
    
    -- Bottom 1 Performer
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 1 THEN CAST(rn_top AS VARCHAR) END), '0') AS bot_1_rank,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 1 THEN name END), '') AS bot_1_name,
    Coalesce(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 1 THEN division END), '') AS bot_1_div,
    Coalesce(FormatNumber(Round(MAX(CASE WHEN rn_bot = 1 THEN payout END), 0), '#,###'), '0') AS bot_1_val

FROM (
    SELECT 
        name,
        division,
        payout,
        Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY payout DESC) AS rn_top,
        Row_Number() OVER (ORDER BY payout ASC) AS rn_bot
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SubString(p.participant_name, 0, IndexOf(p.participant_name, '(')) AS name,
            m.category AS division, 
            SUM(p.amount) AS payout
        FROM xactly.xc_payment p
        
        -- Embedded Title Mapping
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                ppa.participant_id AS master_participant_id,
                pta.title_name AS title_name
            FROM xactly.xc_period per 
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_part_assignment ppa 
                ON ppa.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_position pos 
                ON ppa.position_id = pos.position_id
                AND CAST(per.end_date AS DATE) >= CAST(pos.effective_start_date AS DATE)
                AND CAST(per.start_date AS DATE) <= CAST(pos.effective_end_date AS DATE)
            INNER JOIN xactly.xc_pos_title_assignment pta 
                ON pos.position_id = pta.position_id
            WHERE per.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        ) pta ON p.participant_id = pta.master_participant_id
        
        INNER JOIN NATERA_MASTER_MAPPING m 
            ON p.earning_group_name = m.earning_group
            AND pta.title_name = m.title
            
        WHERE p.participant_id IN :v_child_master_participant_id
          AND p.period_id IN :v_month_period_ids
        GROUP BY 
            p.participant_name, 
            m.category
    ) AggData
) RankedData;
